title: Usps Metric1 Monthly Rollup
dataSources: Move checklists (`move:checklist`), USPS change-of-address (`usps:change`), mover quotes (`mover:quote`), utility transfers (`utility:transfer`), and box inventories (`box:inventory`).
app: Move checklist task exports, USPS change-of-address confirmations, mover quote comparisons, utility transfer logs, and box inventory scans forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=usps:metric1
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as events, sum(value) as total_value by _time
| sort _time
description: Summarises monthly event volume and total value for usps metric1 (1) data.
value: Monthly rollups smooth daily noise and show seasonal shifts in personal activity.
implementation: Aggregate usps metric1 (1) events monthly and chart count plus total value.
visualization: Column chart of monthly events with total value overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It catches how your usps metric1 (1) activity added up each month instead of day by day.
